stories.title: LIVE-TICKER - Krieg in der Ukraine: Trump kündigt Energie-Waffenstillstand zwischen Moskau und Kiew an +++ Drohnenalarm an Moskauer Flughäfen

en.title: LIVE TICKER - War in Ukraine: Trump announces energy ceasefire between Moscow and Kyiv +++ Drone alarm at Moscow airports
en.summary: Russia has been waging war against Ukraine for over four years. The ticker covers major developments in the ongoing conflict.

stories.title: En Inde, les chefs du Parti des cafards remis en liberté appellent à de nouvelles manifestations

en.title: In India, leaders of the Cockroach Party released call for new protests
en.summary: Released after detention in New Delhi, youth movement leaders vowed to continue demonstrations demanding the resignation of the electoral commission president following the removal of 130 million voters.

stories.title: Au moins 139 migrants morts et 84 disparus dans un naufrage au large de Djibouti

en.title: At least 139 migrants dead and 84 missing in shipwreck off Djibouti
en.summary: An overloaded vessel carrying over 300 passengers, mostly Ethiopians bound for Yemen, sank off Djibouti. The UN reported the incident as part of ongoing migration across the eastern maritime route.

stories.title: En France, l'eurodéputé Raphaël Glucksmann est désigné candidat de la gauche sociale-démocrate

en.title: In France, MEP Raphaël Glucksmann designated candidate of the social-democratic left
en.summary: MEP Raphaël Glucksmann won the primary election for the social-democratic left's presidential candidate, securing over 66 percent of votes in the first round.

stories.title: Angriffe auf Flughafen in Riad – Die Huthi greifen das Geschäftsmodell Saudi-Arabiens an

en.title: Attacks on Riyadh airport – The Huthis are targeting Saudi Arabia's business model
en.summary: The conflict between Houthi forces and Saudi Arabia is escalating. A Middle East correspondent provides analysis of the situation.

stories.title: Krieg im Nahen Osten – Anschlag auf den Flughafen in Riad: Huthi-Rebellen bekennen sich

en.title: War in the Middle East – Attack on Riyadh airport: Houthi rebels claim responsibility
en.summary: A militia claimed responsibility for a Saturday attack on Riyadh airport in which 12 people died during a televised statement.

stories.title: «Il a plié le match»: Raphaël Glucksmann s’impose comme le candidat de la gauche sociale-démocrate et se met en route vers l’Elysée

en.title: "He dominated the contest": Raphaël Glucksmann establishes himself as the social-democratic left candidate and heads toward the Élysée
en.summary: The Place publique MEP secured over 66% of votes in a social-democratic primary election, winning in the first round with nearly 80,000 votes from approximately 120,000 participants.

stories.title: Troisième de l’Ironman d’Hawaï, Julie Derron va-t-elle persévérer sur les triathlons de longue distance?

en.title: Third at Hawaii's Ironman, will Julie Derron continue with long-distance triathlons?
en.summary: Swiss triathlete Julie Derron finished third at the Hawaii Ironman following her silver medal at Paris 2024 Olympics. She must decide whether to pursue ultra-distance racing before the Los Angeles 2028 Games.

stories.title: Chaostage im Königreich: Die Huthi greifen den Flughafen von Riad an – jetzt steht Mohammed bin Salman unter Druck

en.title: Chaotic days in the kingdom: The Huthis attack Riyadh airport – Mohammed bin Salman now faces pressure
en.summary: Thirteen people were killed and over 300 wounded in Saturday's attack on Riyadh airport, one of Saudi Arabia's worst attacks. While residents show composure, the kingdom faces difficult times ahead.

stories.title: Au moins 139 migrants meurent dans un naufrage au large de Djibouti

en.title: At least 139 migrants die in shipwreck off Djibouti
en.summary: A vessel traveling toward Yemen sank off Djibouti on the night of October 8-9, resulting in at least 139 deaths and 84 missing persons, according to UN figures released Sunday.

stories.title: «Ein Tag wie eine Achterbahn»: Julie Derron wird bei ihrem Hawaii-Debüt an der Ironman-Weltmeisterschaft Dritte

en.title: "A day like a roller coaster": Julie Derron finishes third at her Hawaii debut at the Ironman World Championship
en.summary: Julie Derron placed third in her debut at the Ironman World Championship in Hawaii. The legendary race demonstrated that victory goes not to the fittest athlete, but to the one whose body endures the extreme demands.

stories.title: Entdeckt im frühen Stadium – Knoten in der Lunge: Papst wird operiert

en.title: Discovered in Early Stage – Lung Nodule: Pope to Undergo Surgery
en.summary: The Pope announced that a lung nodule was detected at an early stage and requires surgical intervention. The procedure is scheduled to take place in the coming days.

stories.title: Eine Gruppe wollte den Skibetrieb in Braunwald retten – doch ihr Übernahmeangebot blieb unbeantwortet

en.title: A Group Wanted to Save Ski Operations in Braunwald – But Their Takeover Offer Went Unanswered
en.summary: An initiative attempted to purchase the main shareholder's stake in Braunwald's ski facilities to prevent closure of traditional ski operations. The shareholder did not respond to the offer, leaving the takeover attempt unsuccessful.

stories.title: Der Franken ist weiterhin ein sicherer Hafen – dies zeigen die Sorgen über Frankreich und eine mögliche Euro-Schuldenkrise

en.title: The franc remains a safe haven – concerns about France and a potential euro debt crisis demonstrate this
en.summary: The franc has weakened slightly against the euro in recent months but remains a safe haven. Private investors should exercise caution with investments in other currencies or hedge currency risk.

stories.title: Die Stadt Rafah gibt es nicht mehr

en.title: The city of Rafah no longer exists
en.summary: More than two years after an Israeli military operation in the Gaza Strip city, nearly all buildings including schools, mosques, and homes have been destroyed, with satellite imagery showing the area as rubble.

stories.title: Von der Schweiz schwärmen und dafür bezahlt werden: Nina Chuba übernimmt das Privileg von Roger Federer

en.title: Praising Switzerland and getting paid for it: Nina Chuba takes over the privilege of Roger Federer
en.summary: German artist Nina Chuba has been hired to promote Swiss autumn holidays for a fee, following in the footsteps of retired ambassador Roger Federer who now resides in Rapperswil-Jona.

stories.title: Schweizer Online-Giganten bezweifeln, dass sich die KI-Agenten fürs Shopping durchsetzen werden

en.title: Swiss online giants doubt that AI shopping agents will catch on
en.summary: Galaxus and Brack are preparing for digital shopping assistants, but they question whether such AI agents will achieve widespread adoption in Switzerland.
